instruction: Candid photographic full shot from behind of two young women running hand-in-hand down a city street. The blonde woman in a black puffer vest (R2) on the left and the red-haired woman in a light blue knit vest (R1) on the right are captured mid-stride, running away from the camera. Their hair blows in the wind as they jog down the center of the asphalt road. The background shows parked cars and trees under soft, natural daylight.
